title: Compute onset of plastic flow
action: Using the given geometry, loading, and material parameters (R=5 mm, M=10 kg, v0=2 m/s, K=200 MN/m, δ0=0.13 mm, σ_s0=59 MPa, E=10 GPa), compute the plastic flow onset time t1, initial mean pressure p0, impactor velocity v(t1), and contact surface velocity w(t1) from the elastic impact formulas given in the Approach. Store these values for the simulation step.
description: Compute initial conditions for the viscoplastic ODE integration.

title: Simulate baseline impact and extract final values
action: Implement the system of five ODEs detailed in the Approach section: the mean pressure relation, the adiabatic heat balance, and the kinematic/dynamic equations. Use μ=0, the baseline parameters (R=5 mm, M=10 kg, v0=2 m/s, K=200 MN/m, δ0=0.13 mm, σ_s0=59 MPa, E=10 GPa, Tm0=413 K, T0=293 K, β=0.2 K/MPa, n=0.6, ρc_p=2 J/(cm³·K)), and the initial conditions from step_compute_onset. Integrate with an explicit Runge-Kutta method (e.g., solve_ivp with 'RK45') from t1 to termination (v=0 or T ≥ Tm). From the time series, find the peak pressure after t1 (t_peak). Extract t1, p0, tm = t_peak - t1, tp = t_end - t_peak, and final values pk, Tk, vk, wk, δk at termination. Convert units and write to final_values.json.
description: Final characteristic quantities for the baseline parameter set.
output_schema: JSON object with numeric keys: t1_us (time in µs), p0_GPa (pressure in GPa), tm_us (time in µs), tp_us (time in µs), pk_GPa (pressure in GPa), Tk_K (temperature in K), vk_m_per_s (velocity in m/s), wk_m_per_s (velocity in m/s), delta_k_mm (thickness in mm).

title: Optional: re-run with δ0=1 mm
action: (Optional) Repeat the baseline simulation with the initial disk thickness changed to δ0 = 1 mm, keeping all other parameters exactly as in the baseline. Write the same set of final values to the file delta0_1mm_final_values.json. The file format and keys are the same as in final_values.json.
description: Run simulation with δ0 = 1 mm for optional structural trend verification.
output_schema: JSON object with numeric keys: t1_us, p0_GPa, tm_us, tp_us, pk_GPa, Tk_K, vk_m_per_s, wk_m_per_s, delta_k_mm.
